description: Add a DNS record (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS). Takes effect on the internet; ask the user first.

content.description: What the record points to, and it depends on the type: an IPv4 address for A (93.184.216.34), an IPv6 address for AAAA, a hostname for CNAME and NS (www.example.com), priority and host for MX (10 mail.example.com), and free text for TXT.

name.description: @ for the domain itself, or a sub-name like www.

proxied.description: Through Cloudflare's proxy (A, AAAA, CNAME only).

type.description: Record type. Pick it from what you want: A for an IPv4 address, AAAA for IPv6, CNAME to point at another name, MX for mail, TXT for verification, NS to delegate.

name: create_dns_record
title: Create DNS record
